title: Dragon Ball
source: Dragon Ball manga by Akira Toriyama and Dragon Ball Super manga (Toyotarou, ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published Super arc.
world: Saiyan warrior Goku grows from a monkey-tailed boy into Earth's greatest defender, fighting ever stronger foes alongside his rival, Saiyan prince Vegeta. Wishes come from the seven Dragon Balls. In Dragon Ball Super they train with the gods of destruction and angels, compete in the Tournament of Power, and face new threats across the multiverse. Upbeat martial-arts action, big transformations and family comedy.
power_system: Fighters use ki for flight, energy blasts (Kamehameha, Galick Gun, Final Flash) and sensing. Saiyans transform (Super Saiyan, God, Blue); Goku reaches Ultra Instinct and Vegeta Ultra Ego. Collecting all seven Dragon Balls summons the dragon Shenron to grant wishes.
